filters.label: Date Range
filters.name: dateRange
filters.description: Filter sessions by creation date range

filters.label: User
filters.name: userRef
filters.description: Filter by session owner. Displayed as displayName in UI. Selection resolved to opaque userRef before filter is applied — raw userId is never placed in a URL query string.
filters.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: user filter passes an opaque userRef in the request context, not a raw POPA s.17 userId in the URL query string

runAction.label: Apply Filters
runAction.description: Fetch the filtered session list from listSessions (GET /api/v1/sessions) using admin-scope JWT. Only sessions belonging to the current tenant are returned (BR-001 tenant isolation).

columns.description: Truncated UUID displayed as short ID (first 8 chars)
planningSession.userId resolved to displayName from user context. Raw userId is never rendered in the UI.
columns.securityNote: FAC-S5-025: raw userId is masked to displayName. Annotate component render with // ASVS:V-8.3.1 and // CAS:RULE-017

rowDetailPanel.description: Inline detail panel expanded on row click. Does not navigate away from page.

fields.label: Export History
fields.description: Number of times this session has been exported via initiateExport

adminAnnotation.label: Governance Note
adminAnnotation.name: adminAnnotation
adminAnnotation.description: Governance tracking note visible only to planner-admin and tenant-admin roles. Saved to session metadata via updateSession PATCH.

emptyState.message: No planning sessions match the selected filters. Try adjusting your date range or removing filters.

exportAction.label: Export Results
exportAction.description: Export the current filtered session list as CSV or JSON. Fetches all matching sessions via listSessions (paginated, admin-scope) and formats client-side.
exportAction.exportNote: No dedicated bulk export endpoint in OpenAPI spec. Export is generated client-side from listSessions paginated result set with current filter state applied. TC-043: CSV includes sessionId, ownerDisplayName, status, createdAt, lastActivityAt, businessProblemSummary. TC-044: JSON export same fields. Raw userId is NOT included in either export format (FAC-S5-025).

accessControl.description: Only admin roles can export. planner-user receives 403.

pagination.description: Server-side pagination via page and pageSize params on GET /api/v1/sessions

onLoad.description: Fetches paginated planning sessions for the tenant. planner-admin and tenant-admin roles receive all tenant sessions per BR-007 JWT role-based filter. Returns status, createdAt, lastActivityAt, businessProblemSummary, and ownerDisplayName resolved from userId.
onLoad.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: Status and date-range are standard non-PII query params. User filter uses opaque userRef in component state; not passed as raw userId in URL query string.

onSubmit.description: Saves admin governance annotation to the session record. Only invoked when admin modifies the annotation field in the row detail panel.

dataBindings.emptyState: No planning sessions match the selected filters. Try adjusting your date range or removing filters.

accessControl.deniedMessage: You do not have permission to view session history. This area is restricted to tenant administrators and platform administrators.
accessControl.crossTenantNote: TC-041: listSessions is tenant-scoped per BR-001. planner-admin cannot see sessions from other tenants. TC-042: admin cannot see other tenant user data. ownerDisplayName is resolved within current tenant context only.

errorStates.message: You do not have permission to view session history.

errorStates.condition: listSessions returns empty set with active filters
errorStates.message: No planning sessions match the selected filters. Try adjusting your date range or removing filters.
Session history is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few moments.
Unable to save governance note. Please check the note content and try again.

protectedFields.maskingRule: FAC-S5-025: render display name from user context lookup; never render raw Keycloak userId in table, detail panel, or export output

securityContext.urlLeakageNote: FAC-S5-024: User filter uses opaque userRef resolved from dropdown selection; not a raw POPA s.17 userId in URL query string. listSessions standard query params (status, page, pageSize) do not carry Protected B data.
securityContext.storageNote: FAC-S5-026: No Protected B fields written to localStorage or sessionStorage. Filter state (status, date range) held in component state only. Business problem summaries and session content are Protected B deliberative process records — never persisted client-side.

tcCoverage.description: TC-038: planner-admin sees all tenant sessions via listSessions admin scope. TC-041: cross-tenant sessions not visible (BR-001 tenant isolation). TC-042: admin cannot see other tenant user data. TC-043: CSV export of filtered results. TC-044: JSON export of filtered results. TC-055: keyboard navigation for filters, table, detail panel, and export action. TC-057: colour contrast for status badges and error states. TC-080: session access by owner (planner-user sees only own sessions via listSessions; admin sees all). TC-081: admin annotation saved via updateSession PATCH.

policyNotices.description: Session owner identity (userId) is a personal identifier. Displayed as displayName only. Raw userId is never rendered in the UI or included in exports.
Business problem summaries and session content are protected deliberative process records under ATIA s.23.
All session queries are tenant-scoped. Admin view is limited to sessions within the current tenant.

metadata.exportNote: No dedicated bulk session-list export endpoint in OpenAPI spec. Export is generated client-side from listSessions paginated result. Raw userId excluded from all export formats per POPA s.17.
